risk_if_not_implemented: Without Authorize Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), security, compliance and resilience activities may lack direction, ownership and executive support, leaving required controls unperformed. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Harm from Unauthorized / Unintended Product or Service Use (R-SC-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14).

compensating_control_1.name: Identity & Access Management (IAM)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of Identification and Access Management (IAM) controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Identity & Access Management (IAM) (IAC-02) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Authorize Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) (GOV-11.4) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk Assessment
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct recurring assessments of risk that includes the likelihood and magnitude of harm, from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification or destruction of the organization's Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Assessment (RSK-13) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Authorize Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) (GOV-11.4) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
